    WITH q AS (
      SELECT websearch_to_tsquery('english', $1) AS tsq

    lexical AS (

        p.feature_id,
        p.content_hash,

        row_number() OVER (

      FROM lexical AS l
      JOIN public.atlas_packets AS p
